agricultural_employer_threshold.observation_prompt: Extract the queried person's exact identifier and calendar year from the current question, and all remuneration/service events stated in the current case. Normalize explicit dates to canonical YYYY-MM-DD while retaining the verbatim source substring. Preserve payer, payee, the exact labor characterization, amount, inclusive service period, and whether the text expressly characterizes the whole amount as wages. Do not allocate a cross-year amount, infer wages or agricultural labor from silence, apply a monetary threshold, or decide employer status. Put genuinely ambiguous coherent readings in separate views; use unknown or failed extraction status instead of an empty resolved event list.

family_employment_A.observation_prompt: Extract only factual employment and family-relation observations from the current facts and question. Preserve exact person identifiers, relationship direction, and verbatim supporting substrings. Represent “X has father Y” as owner X, relationship father, relative Y; do not invert it, decide any statutory issue, infer an unstated gender, or treat an absent relation as negative. Each view must be one coherent reading of the same current case. Use unknown or failed extraction status when relevant text cannot be unambiguously extracted.

qualifying_child_residence_gate.observation_prompt: Extract the exact child, taxpayer, and taxable-year identifiers from the current question and every stated shared-home interval from the current case. For each interval, list exactly the people expressly said to share that home throughout the interval, normalize explicit endpoints to inclusive YYYY-MM-DD dates, and retain a verbatim supporting substring. Do not determine qualifying-child status, decide whether a home is legally a principal abode, infer co-residence from kinship, or turn missing dates into a full-year interval. Put genuinely ambiguous coherent readings in separate views; use unknown or failed extraction status rather than an empty resolved record.

agricultural_employer_threshold.observation_prompt: Extract a finite factual record from only the current facts and question. Identify the exact claimant named in the question and the queried calendar year. Extract each distinct remuneration or service event with its literal payer, payee, amount, inclusive canonical start and end dates, the text's characterization of the labor, and whether the text expressly characterizes the entire amount as wages. Preserve null for unresolved labor or wage characterization, do not allocate a cross-year amount between years, and do not duplicate it. Set extraction status to resolved only when all potentially relevant supplied payment records and their required fields were extracted unambiguously; otherwise use unknown or failed. Attach exact nonempty verbatim current-case quotes. Do not total amounts, test the threshold, determine employer status, or provide the final answer.

family_employment_A.observation_prompt: Read only the current facts and question. Identify the literal employer and employee named by the question; collect every expressly stated family relation as a tuple (owner, literal relation word, relative), without reversing or legally classifying it; and report whether the text expressly states that the identified employee performed work for or was employed by the identified employer. Attach exact nonempty verbatim quotes from the current facts or question to every observation. Use unknown when a requested fact cannot be established; absence of a family mention is not a negative relation fact. Do not decide whether the statutory clause applies or provide the final answer.

qualifying_child_residence_gate.observation_prompt: Extract only residence facts from the current facts and question. Identify the exact proposed child, taxpayer, and queried taxable year named in the question. Record every supplied interval during which explicitly listed persons shared the same home, using inclusive canonical start and end dates. Keep separate observations as separate events; do not calculate duration, infer a principal-abode legal conclusion, or decide qualifying-child status. Set extraction status to resolved only when all supplied residence observations and their dates were extracted unambiguously; otherwise use unknown or failed. Attach exact nonempty verbatim quotes from the current facts or question to every role and event. Do not provide the final answer.
